name: dify-canvas-marketplace
description: Dify 工作流画布插件市场：读取、修改、发布并试运行草稿

plugins.name: dify-canvas
plugins.description: 通过本机已登录的 Chrome 读取、修改、发布并试运行 Dify 工作流画布草稿。可改节点的提示词、代码、变量与连线坐标，可发布草稿，可试跑一轮定位分支问题。
plugins.description_en: Read, patch, publish and test-run Dify workflow canvas drafts through the user's signed-in Chrome.
